title: The commit-msg hook falsely refuses KB-Work on git commit --amend -F, reading HEAD instead of its parent
goal: kg_hooks notes an amend however git names it to prepare-commit-msg (with -F or -m git passes only the source message, not commit HEAD), so commit-msg diffs against HEAD's parent and an amended sprint-close commit naming the closed sprint gets no false KB-Work refusal; check-trailers already passes it. Found closing SP-6btkjg4l: the hook printed has SP-6btkjg4l; expected one line of backlog item ids that exist, and the push went through, the warned-yet-pushed case ST-p2a2rzkf meant to remove.

run:
import os,sys,subprocess,tempfile; t=os.path.abspath('_tools');d=tempfile.mkdtemp();h=os.path.join(d,'.git','hooks','prepare-commit-msg'); g=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git','-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@corp.example.com',*a],cwd=d,capture_output=True); g('init','-q');open(os.path.join(d,'a'),'w').write('a');g('add','-A');g('commit','-qm','one'); open(h,'w').write('#!/bin/sh
exec "%s" -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, %r); import kg_hooks, os; kg_hooks.KB = os.getcwd(); kg_hooks.hook_prepare(sys.argv[1:])" "$@"
'%(sys.executable,t));os.chmod(h,0o755); open(os.path.join(d,'m'),'w').write('one again
');g('commit','-q','--amend','-F','m'); sys.exit(0 if os.path.exists(os.path.join(d,'.git','kb-trailers-base')) else 1)
